|game_text=Plays on table. Cancels [[Order To Engage]] and [[Scramble]]. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, [[Staging Areas]] is suspended. "Missing" on [[Lost In The Wilderness]] is treated as "landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn."
|errata_history=This card has one published text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints it.
* The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012 and in every capture to 12 February 2013)<ref name="cl-1200_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 13 December 2012 and 12 February 2013 (the capture of 31 May 2013 shows no text)</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended. 'Missing' on Lost In The Wilderness is treated as 'landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.'” (The card list writes the ▲ out and uses single quotes.)
* The Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet (21 May 2013)<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet] (Defensive Shield pages of the Virtual Cards Master List, PDF made 21 May 2013), PDF page 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text on both •Fanfare (V) slips (this card and [[Fanfare (V) (Tatooine) (Virtual Shields)|Fanfare (Tatooine) (V)]]): “Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended. "Missing" on Lost In The Wilderness is treated as "landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn."” The Virtual Cards Master List prints the same (Dark Side p. 17)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>.
* Not versions of this card: the shorter text “Plays on table. Cancels Order To Engage and Scramble. Once per game, you may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Staging Areas is suspended.” is the sheet's slip for the Decipher shield •Fanfare (no “(V)”; see [[Fanfare (Defensive Shield)]]), and the text with Ice Storm and Sandwhirl that this page carried until 9 November 2026 is the Virtual Set D card [[Fanfare (Reflections III) (V)]] (PC card data copy).
